name: Skuruhatt - Valbacken
description: Skuruhatt to Valbacken. Candidate import from normalized research; verify current notices before publication.
waterSources: No verified potable water source is listed for this section; carry water and treat natural water.
notes: Official title says Skuruhatt; route text says start at Skurugata; GPX starts at the Skurugata/Skuruhatt visitor area.

Official HÖ2 page states the trail has been rerouted before Hässleåsa gård and hikers should follow markings on site. Naturkartan GPX and API linework match each other and were updated/fetched in this research pass, but the page does not say whether the geometry fully reflects the reroute.
AllTrails, Pacer and SityTrail still use older Klinten-Ingatorp sectioning and shorter 29.6-31 km distances, while current official HÖ2 is Skuruhatt-Valbacken, 32.1 km.
HÖ2 page says Skurugata is 800 m and Skuruhatt 337 m above sea level; Länsstyrelsen describes the gorge as about 1 km and Skuruhatt as 334 m.
Official Naturkartan/Smålandsleden says 3-4 people; Vindskyddskartan reportedly says 4-6/sleeps 6.
Valbacken cafe/toilet/water are official but seasonal/opening-dependent; the toilet is closed in winter.

facilities.name: Skurugata / Skuruhatt parking
facilities.description: Large visitor parking for the Skurugata/Skuruhatt reserve and the HÖ1/HÖ2/HÖ17 junction. Parking only in designated places; no overnighting in vehicle, camper or roof tent inside the reserve.

facilities.name: Skuruhatt viewpoint
facilities.description: Skuruhatt viewpoint above the ravine; official sources describe wide views and the high point above Skurugata. Coordinate is OSM-sourced; HÖ1 research also found nearby official Naturkartan viewpoint/fireplace objects that should be deduplicated.

facilities.name: Skuruhatt fireplace
facilities.description: Fireplace/rest area in the Skuruhatt top cluster. Deduplicate against separate Skurugata fire/rest-area records from HÖ1 research.

facilities.name: Klinten shelters, Försjön
facilities.description: Two shelters for four people each at Försjön, in a sheltered location. Official page also lists tables.

facilities.name: Klinten fireplaces
facilities.description: Two grill/fire sites plus wood store and tables at the Klinten/Försjön shelter cluster. Cluster with Klinten shelter; fire only at designated places and subject to fire bans.

facilities.name: Klinten dry toilet
facilities.description: Dry toilet at the north end of Försjön near the shelter/beach cluster.

facilities.name: Klintaberget viewpoint
facilities.description: Viewpoint in Klinten nature reserve, near the official HÖ2 route and Klinten loops. Slightly off the main GPX; likely a short viewpoint spur or nearby loop feature.

facilities.name: Stuverydsbäcken parking and information board
facilities.description: Reserve parking and information point for Stuverydsbäcken/Skrôle Hie where HÖ2 passes the reserve. User field reports say parking has no toilet or trash; do not infer facilities beyond official parking/rest/fire information.

facilities.name: Lövsjön shelter
facilities.description: Shelter for 3-4 people by Lövsjön. Official page says there is a fireplace but no dry toilet.

facilities.name: Lövsjön fireplace
facilities.description: Fireplace at the Lövsjön shelter. The official page explicitly says no dry toilet is available.

facilities.name: Nässjasjön shelter
facilities.description: Smaller shelter for 3-4 people by Nässjasjön. Official page says there is a simple fireplace and sandy-bottom swimming.

facilities.name: Nässjasjön fireplace
facilities.description: Simple fireplace at the Nässjasjön shelter.

facilities.name: Nässjasjön swimming
facilities.description: Natural swimming opportunity by Nässjasjön with sandy bottom according to the official shelter page.

facilities.name: Valbacken shelter
facilities.description: Shelter for four people on a short spur at Valbacken, with tables and a grill place. Shelter lies on a short spur near the endpoint; cluster with Valbacken ledentré facilities.

facilities.name: Valbacken shelter fireplace
facilities.description: Grill/fireplace and tables at the Valbacken shelter.

facilities.name: Valbackens Toppstuga toilet and water
facilities.description: Toilet and water in the basement of Valbackens Toppstuga. Official page says the toilet is closed in winter. Seasonal/currentness caveat: toilet and water are closed in winter; summer cafe opening hours may affect service.

facilities.name: Valbackens café Dalens Topp
facilities.description: Summer cafe at Valbacken serving fika, sandwiches, waffles and drinks when open. Commercial/seasonal service; verify opening hours before user-facing guidance.

facilities.name: Valbacken viewpoint
facilities.description: Viewpoint at Valbacken with views over Ingatorp and its church.

facilities.name: Valbacken parking
facilities.description: Parking at the Valbacken ski/trail entrance area.

facilities.name: Movänta Camping
facilities.description: Camping/lodging/service area off the HÖ2 route near Försjön/Klinten. Useful as detour/service metadata, not an on-route facility. About 1.5 km off route; commercial/currentness dependency.

facilities.name: Ingatorp services
facilities.description: Food/lodging/services in Ingatorp are about 0.75-0.8 km from Valbacken endpoint and are useful as endpoint access context. No individual commercial services were normalized in this pass.
